---
title: "Source identity and ownership"
description: "Keep source geometry, placed occurrences and electrical ownership recognizable in the final product."
sidebar: simulation
---

OrPen supplies the Layout, process records and model intent. SCGSim must carry
that meaning into the solver model and back into user-readable results.
The user must be able to tell which source conductor a native object or
matrix label represents.

## Input supplied by OrPen

- Component/source identity, selected layers and units.
- Local conductor regions, outer rings and holes, ports/supports and material/level associations.
- Actual child occurrences and their local-to-placed transforms.
- Caller-owned final Nets, reference conductors and intended contacts.

A repeated child keeps its occurrence identity. One Net may contain multiple
bodies; that is not an instruction to merge all their geometry.

For a flip-chip coupon, keep the lower Ground, upper Ground and each bump
recognizable even when the caller assigns them to one Ground Net. Keep the
central Pad on its separate Net. Its local outline and holes must remain
distinct from the placed child and the surrounding plane.

## Backend requirements

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Palace

| Workflow stage | Required delivery |
| --- | --- |
| Source to model | Carry Entity/occurrence/Net membership into CAD, physical boundary groups and solution-domain regions. |
| Placement | Apply the authored occurrence transform once to geometry, directions and selections. |
| Electrical ownership | Bind source conductors to potential boundaries, PEC/lumped selections and result labels. |
| Result attribution | Preserve source membership even if the solver groups several regions. |

### AEDT

| Workflow stage | Required delivery |
| --- | --- |
| Source to model | Carry membership into native bodies/sheets, material assignments and excitation selections. |
| Placement | Apply the same placement to bodies and support/terminal selections; no guessed native-object names. |
| Electrical ownership | Bind bodies to requested Net/port/reference types without treating a label as physical connectivity. |
| Result attribution | Preserve native body/Net/terminal ordering and map it back to the requested source owners. |

:::

Q2D starts from the explicitly authored section instead of a placed 3D
component; its region/conductor identity must still reach the output matrices.

## Final product to inspect

A source-to-native mapping table, model preview and ordered result labels.
It must distinguish local and placed coordinates, actual child occurrences
and computational grouping. Detached readout must not depend on mutable live
component objects.

::: {.callout-note title="Follow the source into the model"}

Use [Source ownership](../../notebooks/ComponentSimulation/GeometrySemantics/geometry_source_ownership.ipynb)
for local regions, named occurrences, placed coordinates and final Net
membership. Inspect its source observations first, then the corresponding
backend notebook's native body/group mapping and returned-result labels.
These are separate observation stages, not three names for a source preview.

:::

The [flip-chip coupon](../../public-pdk-examples/test-components.md) supplies
multiple bodies on one Ground and genuine child ownership. Rotation/reflection
uses explicitly authored placements, not renamed flattened polygons.

Serves [capacitance](../requirements/electrostatic-capacitance.qmd),
[eigenmode](../requirements/eigenmode.qmd), [driven terminal](../requirements/driven-terminal.qmd)
and [Q3D](../requirements/q3d-acrl.qmd). No API or internal schema is prescribed here.
